intro.title: Six years of servers, communities and clean handovers.
intro.kicker: Newest first. Each entry is a real engagement — what the brief was, what I configured, and what the team was left with.

entries.title: Lead configurator & operations advisor
entries.summary: Rebuilding a 4-server Velocity network from a single overloaded Paper instance, while training the staff team to run it without me.
highlights: Split survival, creative, minigames and hub onto a Velocity proxy with shared LuckPerms context
Cut average tick time from 41ms to 12ms through plugin auditing and chunk tuning
Wrote a 32-page operations handbook and ran four staff training sessions

entries.title: Discord architect & community manager
entries.summary: Took a 400-member Discord with no structure and turned it into a 12,000-member community with a moderation team that runs itself.
highlights: Designed a 40-channel architecture with progressive role unlocks and a verified onboarding flow
Built ticket routing and auto-moderation that cut manual moderator actions by roughly 70%
Hired and trained an 11-person moderation team on a written escalation ladder

entries.title: Full server configuration
entries.summary: End-to-end configuration for a seasonal SMP — economy, land claims, custom items and the quest chain that carried the first season.
highlights: Balanced a closed-loop economy across shops, jobs and a player market
Configured 60+ custom items in ItemsAdder with matching MythicMobs encounters
Season launched on schedule and held a 38% day-30 player retention

entries.title: Staff lead & permissions rescue
entries.summary: Called in after a permissions rewrite locked out half the staff team mid-season. Rebuilt the hierarchy and stayed on to lead the team.
highlights: Rebuilt a broken 90-group LuckPerms tree into 14 inherited tracks in a weekend
Introduced shift rotas and handover notes across three timezones
Reduced staff turnover from monthly churn to two departures in nine months

entries.title: Bot configuration & automation
entries.summary: A run of automation contracts across eleven Discord communities: verification, tickets, logging, and cross-posting to Minecraft.
highlights: Standardised a reusable verification and ticket stack deployed across all eleven servers
Linked in-game punishments to Discord role changes via webhook relays
Documented every setup so each owner could edit it themselves

entries.title: Started configuring, then never stopped
entries.summary: Learned the craft the usual way — running a friend's survival server, breaking it, and figuring out exactly why it broke.
highlights: Went from single-server Spigot setups to multi-server BungeeCord networks
Picked up permissions, economies and world management the hard way
Started taking paid configuration work in late 2021
